## Publisher / MCP endpoint

- Publisher:

## What should be corrected?

Describe the specific field, schema, behaviour, or timestamp that you believe is inaccurate.

## Evidence

Link to public documentation or a reproducible, non-sensitive example. Do not include credentials, API keys, customer data, or private logs.

## Desired outcome

- [ ] Correct publisher metadata
- [ ] Re-run the test against the current schema
- [ ] Add an explanatory publisher statement
- [ ] Request removal of an outdated observation

LEGION will acknowledge a material right-of-reply submission and allow a 72-hour response window before escalating any adverse public finding. Current published results are not a certification.
